title: Welcome to Agentero
subtitle: Read papers and take notes alongside your AI assistant. A few quick steps to set up your workspace.

theme.title: Pick your look
theme.desc: Choose a color scheme you like — you can change it anytime in Settings.

proxy.title: Set up network access
proxy.desc: Use a local proxy when academic sites, GitHub, or Agent downloads need one.
proxy.hint: Leave the switch off to connect directly, or enable it for a local HTTP/SOCKS proxy.

agent.title: Choose your AI assistant
agent.desc: Agentero plugs into agents already installed on this computer to summarize papers and answer questions — no extra API keys, just pick one.
agent.none: No agents found yet. Install one on this computer (e.g. OpenCode, or Claude Code plus its ACP adapter), then click Rescan.

desktopApps.title: Local desktop apps
desktopApps.hint: (they don't speak ACP themselves — Agentero uses the CLI they bundle)

translate.title: Set up translation
translate.desc: Select text in foreign-language papers to translate it instantly. The built-in option works out of the box.
translate.configureOwn: I have my own translation API
translate.configureOwnDesc: Bring your own DeepL or other translation API key.
translate.useDefaultDesc: Works out of the box with no setup.
translate.probeFail: Check your key and try again

layout.title: Formula & figure parsing
layout.configureOwnDesc: Bring your own Paddle, MinerU, or OpenAI-compatible API key for the best accuracy on figures and formulas.
layout.useDefaultDesc: Runs entirely on your device with no setup and works offline, but uses system resources, is slower, and is less accurate on complex layouts.
layout.selfHostedHint: Using a self-hosted MinerU? Choose "Use the local model" to skip this step, then turn on "Self-hosted API" under Settings → Layout Analysis and fill in the base URL.
layout.probeFail: Check your key and try again

vault.title: Create your library
vault.desc: A vault is just a plain folder on your computer where papers and notes live. You can create or switch to another one anytime.
vault.createDesc: Choose a separate Agentero folder first. After it is created, you can import from Zotero.
vault.readyDesc: Import your first paper to get started. The reading tour will continue when you open it.

sidebar.title: Your library & vault
sidebar.desc: The sidebar holds your paper library, vault folders and discovery sources. Everything is just Markdown and files on your computer.

library.title: Papers library
library.desc: Every paper in your vault shows up here. Sort columns, filter by tags, edit metadata and export BibTeX in one place.

coolPapers.title: Cool Papers
coolPapers.desc: Browse arXiv highlights and trending papers. One click opens an interesting paper in the workspace.

magicWand.title: One-click import
magicWand.desc: Paste a DOI, arXiv ID or link; metadata, PDF and LaTeX source are fetched automatically. {{magicWandShortcut}} opens it anytime.

readPaper.title: Read a paper
readPaper.desc: Read the original PDF here. Page and zoom controls stay at the bottom; notes can sit alongside it.

workspace.title: Split-screen reading
workspace.desc: Open any paper to split the view: PDF on the left, NOTES.md on the right. Select text to highlight, annotate, translate or ask questions.

fullTextTranslate.title: Translation view
fullTextTranslate.desc: Translation / Compare on the PDF toolbar translates the whole paper: Translation overlays it on the page, Compare shows source and translation side by side.

fetchCoolPapersNotes.title: Cool Paper notes
fetchCoolPapersNotes.desc: While editing a paper's NOTES.md, click this button to fetch public Kimi notes from Cool Papers and merge them into your own notes.

agent.title: Your agent, ready to help
agent.desc: Reuses your locally signed-in agent — no API keys. The current paper joins the context automatically; click a suggested question to summarize it.

titlebar.title: Your workspace controls
titlebar.desc: Use the layout menu to arrange your workspace. {{settingsShortcut}} opens Settings and {{quickOpenShortcut}} finds a file or paper.

notes.title: Your paper notes
notes.desc: NOTES.md stays beside the PDF. Your notes are saved automatically as a plain Markdown file in this paper’s folder.

annotations.title: Highlights & annotations
annotations.desc: Select text to highlight it or add a comment. Long comments scroll within their own card without covering nearby notes.

selectionTranslate.title: Translate selected text
selectionTranslate.desc: Select a passage to translate it from the selection toolbar. Page translation is also available in the PDF toolbar, even when its floating entry is hidden.

workspaceNext.title: Try your first paper
workspaceNext.desc: Import a PDF or paste a DOI with {{magicWandShortcut}}. To import into a folder, open that folder first, then right-click an empty area and choose how to import. Open the paper to continue the reading tour. You can also open the tutorial notes or configure an Agent in Settings.

readingNext.title: Keep your reading flowing
readingNext.desc: Try a highlight, add a note, and filter the library by tags. Shift+F11 enters immersive reading; Esc returns to your previous layout.
